prompt: Draw a 600x400 SVG showing a 5x5 grid of equal squares (each 60x60 px, grid centered on the canvas) in which exactly 7 cells are shaded; then determine the minimum number of additional cells that must be shaded so that every row and every column contains at least 2 shaded cells, and shade those added cells in a visibly different color. Constraints: (1) the 7 original shaded cells must be at row-column positions (1,1), (1,2), (2,4), (3,3), (4,5), (5,1), (5,5) with rows numbered top to bottom and columns left to right; (2) include a legend with two labeled color swatches ("original" and "added"); (3) place a title at the top reading "Added cells: N" where N is the correct minimum. All text must be readable and no labels may overlap each other or the grid. Output only the SVG code, nothing else.
